name: Ping priority
description: Classify a free-text note before sending it to an agent, so urgent pings jump the queue. State = the text of the ping.

urgent.instructions: The message conveys urgency or time-sensitivity.

blocking.instructions: The message reports something that blocks the agent's current task.

criteria.true: The agent cannot continue until this is resolved

intent.instructions: What does the sender want the agent to do?
